title: Workspace Limits

items.label: Shared Room
items.description: A student tries to speak in an online class while others talk nearby.
items.visual_focus: a student speaking into a laptop while close by roommates talk
items.local_cue: a compact rented Rajshahi flat with a low study table and several students

items.label: Few Sockets
items.description: Two students reach toward the same power outlet with laptop chargers.
items.visual_focus: two laptop chargers reaching for one wall socket
items.local_cue: two laptop chargers at one socket in a modest Bangladeshi student room

items.label: Video Call Noise
items.description: A learner moves a laptop closer to their face to hear over conversation.
items.visual_focus: a learner cupping one ear to hear a laptop video call over nearby talk
items.local_cue: a video call on a laptop in a shared Rajshahi student room

items.label: Paid Seating
items.description: A worker buys a drink before settling at a café table with a laptop.
items.visual_focus: a worker paying for a drink before using a café table with a laptop
items.local_cue: a small Rajshahi cafe counter and laptop table, with a glass of tea

items.label: Weak Wi-Fi
items.description: A person waits as a laptop video call freezes beside a small router.
items.visual_focus: a frozen video-call symbol on a laptop beside a small router
items.local_cue: a small router and laptop in a Bangladeshi student apartment

items.label: Searching for Desk
items.description: Several people search for a free desk in a crowded study room.
items.visual_focus: a student carrying a laptop while scanning a room of occupied desks
items.local_cue: a crowded Bangladeshi university study room with simple desks

questions: Which two scenes would make an online class hardest?
Where in Rajshahi can you usually work or study well?
Is reliable internet or a quiet desk more urgent? Why?
Why might a café set a minimum purchase for someone using a table?
If a free study room opens, how could crowding change it?
You have 120,000 BDT and 30 days. What one shared-workspace fix would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Pilot a quiet, powered study room with agreed opening and maintenance hours.

evidence.basis: supplied brief plus current university internet reporting
